title: Coastal States Bank President and CEO Named to Georgia 500 Most Influential Leaders List
summary: Coastal States Bank’s (“CSB”) President and CEO, Stephen R
body_markdown:
Coastal States Bank’s (“CSB”) President and CEO, Stephen R. Stone has been named to Georgia Trend's Georgia 500 Most Influential Leaders list.


Honorees are selected through nominations and extensive research to recognize individuals who have the greatest impact on Georgia’s economy, communities, and future growth.


Stone's selection recognizes his 17 years of bank leadership in Georgia, including growing CSB to $2.6 billion in assets, expanding the bank’s footprint with six Georgia branches, and leading the successful IPO and listing of the bank’s holding company, CoastalSouth Bancshares, Inc. on the New York Stock Exchange in 2025.


“It’s an honor to be recognized amongst many great leaders in Georgia,” said Stone. “Community banking is a key driver of the growth and success that our state continues to experience, and it’s my pleasure to lead an outstanding team who impact our local communities every day.”


As a leader in community banking, he has played a key role in strengthening Georgia’s business community by supporting entrepreneurs and business leaders across Metro Atlanta and the Coastal Empire with local relationship banking. Stone also established CSB’s Community Commitment, which has donated more than $360,000 and 375 volunteer hours to Georgia charities and nonprofits.


“Steve understands community banking, leadership principles and, most importantly, he has the character to lead a growing bank,” said James MacLeod, CSB Chairman. “This recognition reflects not only his exceptional leadership and achievements but also his deep commitment to Georgia’s economic future, the state’s banking industry and supporting the communities we serve.”


Click[here](https://editions.mydigitalpublication.com/publication/?i=871747&p=44&view=issueViewer) to view the full Georgia 500 Most Influential List.


**About Coastal States Bank**


Coastal States Bank builds relationships by providing a full range of banking services designed for businesses, their owners and individuals looking for a local banking partner. CSB has a community banking presence in the Lowcountry of South Carolina (Hilton Head Island, Bluffton, Beaufort and Charleston), Savannah and the Atlanta Metropolitan market, and serves communities across the country through its Government Guaranteed Lending, Senior Housing, Correspondent Marine and Mortgage Banker Finance lines of business. At present, CSB has approximately $2.6 billion in total assets.


CSB is a wholly-owned subsidiary of CoastalSouth Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: COSO).


Coastal States Bank – Local. And Proud of It.®
